content: Rolapitant, when co-administered with ozanimod, increases the toxicity of ozanimod by inhibiting the breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP). This interaction elevates the exposure of both minor (RP101988, RP101075) and major active metabolites (CC112273, CC1084037) of ozanimod, potentially heightening the risk of adverse reactions. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, close monitoring is essential. Caution is advised, and patients should be closely monitored. Pentobarbital reduces the efficacy of rolapitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Long-term co-administration of strong CYP3A4 inducers, such as pentobarbital, may significantly decrease the therapeutic effect of rolapitant. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug.
